name: hostile-exchange-offer
title: 425 - Orion Labs Hostile Exchange Offer
filingText:
Filed by Orion Labs, Inc.
Pursuant to Rule 425 under the Securities Act of 1933 and deemed filed pursuant to Rule 14d-2 under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934
Subject Company: Photon Wireless, Inc.
Commission File No. 000-32929

Orion Labs Announces Intention to Commence Hostile Exchange Offer for Photon Wireless

Orion Labs, Inc. (NASDAQ: ORLB) announced that it has filed a Form 425 formally announcing its intention to commence a hostile exchange offer to acquire all outstanding shares of Photon Wireless, Inc. (NASDAQ: PHWN). The proposed offer is expected to consist of a mix of cash and Orion Labs common stock. Orion Labs believes Photon shareholders should have a direct path to consider the proposal. This communication relates to a proposal that Orion Labs has made for a business combination transaction with Photon. In furtherance of this proposal, Orion may file one or more registration statements, proxy statements, tender or exchange offer documents with the SEC.
